Two yellow triangles with apex at the centre O are the sections of the cones on the bottom and top faces, and four small blue circles sit in the corners, each touching the bottom or top side and the side of a cone. Enlarged corner at P: the blue circle with centre S touches the bottom face at U and the side of the yellow cone at T; the red radii SU and ST are labelled r, with a right-angle mark at T.
